title: Injunctive Norms Outperform Reciprocity: Tip Request Messages Can Increase Tipping Without Reducing Demand
authors: Seung Hyun Kim; On Amir; Kenneth C. Wilbur
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Two randomized field experiments on Fiverr (web and app): feols(binary_tip ~ message + `Three Defaults`) and feols(binary_tip ~ treatment) with buyer-clustered SEs, on transaction-level data by buyer type and exposure; no fixed effects or adoption timing. The package ships synthetic data.
design_notes: R (fixest); Table2.R-Table5.R, Figure5.R, Figure6.R. Web_FE.csv and App_FE.csv. Three Defaults effect identified by comparing Control-message rows across the test and post-test periods (one common switch date).
data_files_note: README: Fiverr NDA; buyer/seller IDs replaced and binary_tip, order_amount, tip_amount synthetically generated from models fit to the real data.
screener_notes: Screened from package, README and OpenAlex abstract (no article text).
